faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TLSC Begunia Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Para Legal Volunteer posts is 14th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Para Legal Volunteer position is 18 years. There is no upper age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Para Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Matriculation or an equivalent examination from a recognized board to be eligible for the Para Legal Volunteer post.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the TLSC Begunia Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Para Legal Volunteer recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer position is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form for the TLSC Begunia Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Taluk Legal Services Committee Begunia. The link to the official website is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there are 0 vacancies announced for the Para Legal Volunteer post. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.
